note: Stanley County publishes its adopted zoning ordinance as a PDF and no zoning district polygons as a queryable service. The county GIS (gis.districtiii.org/stanley) is an ArcGIS web app with no discoverable public REST zoning layer; the Equatorstudios viewer is commercial and exposes no service. Fort Pierre (the largest city, in the county) publishes its zoning map only as a PDF. ArcGIS search found no Stanley County zoning layer.
